title: rubia cordifolia subsp. hexaphylla
intro: Rubia cordifolia subsp. hexaphylla, commonly known as Indian madder or six-leaved madder, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family known for its medicinal and ornamental properties. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Rubia cordifolia subsp. hexaphylla include anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for pain relief, wound healing, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinones, particularly rubiadin and rubiarbon, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and coloration.
